pending_commit.commit_message: UPSTREAM: vc/intel/fsp/fsp1_1/braswell: Update FspUpdVpd.h to v 1.1.7.0 Cherry-pick from Chromium 414024e. Update the FSP 1.1 header to version 1.1.7.0, required for susequent Chromium cherry-picks and to-be-merged Braswell CrOS devices. As this header update doesn't shift offsets, only adds new fields in previously unused/reserved space, it should not negatively impact existing boards built against the older header version. UPSTREAM: nb/intel/i945/raminit.c: Refactor tRD selection Inspired by gm45 code, which sets this value the same way. Some values for tRD on 800 and 1067MHz FSB were set wrong because the CAS/Freq selection was wrong. CAS was often selected to low and when fixing CAS this results in tRD being too high, due to an incorrect lookup table which caused instability. PASSED memtest86+ during 10h+ on 1067MHZ fsb with 667MHz ddr2, CAS 5 on GA-945GCM-S2L. BUG=none BRANCH=none TEST=none Change-Id: I622bb18d45c03e894ba021a1120cbfffef798b85 Signed-off-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@google.com> Original-Commit-Id: 250272340bcc2132d6af42c4f2761526890f6bf4 Original-Change-Id: I8002daf25b7603131b78b01075f43fd23747dd94 Original-Signed-off-by: Arthur Heymans <arthur@aheymans.xyz> Original-Reviewed-on: https://review.coreboot.org/18354 Original-Tested-by: build bot (Jenkins) <no-reply@coreboot.org> Original-Reviewed-by: Nico Huber <nico.h@gmx.de> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/652905 Commit-Ready: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Tested-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Patrick Georgi <pgeorgi@chromium.org>

UPSTREAM: arch/x86/Kconfig: Add deprecation warnings for LATE_CBMEM_INIT The deprecation of late (post-romstage) CBMEM initialization was announced in this blog post: https://blogs.coreboot.org/blog/2017/05/08/announcing-coreboot-4-6/ There are two warnings: * In LATE_CBMEM_INIT's help text, I've added a multi-line warning, that aims to explain the problem. * In src/mainboard/Kconfig (just below the mainboard selection), there's a warning which points the user at LATE_CBMEM_INIT, if such a board is selected. Also update the function that needs to be implemented, as pointed out by Keith Hui and Kysti Mlkki.
